name: handover
description: /handover writes a handover note from the conversation (served from the prompt cache), saves it under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/handovers/<session-title>.md, clears the session and continues from the note in a fresh context. Suggests it when context passes a threshold.

threshold.title: Suggest at context %
threshold.description: When the context window passes this, /handover is suggested in the prompt box, and again every 20 points after. 0 = never suggest.
